title: SYNTHETIC: HTTP flood against the customer portal
description: SYNTHETIC. The load balancer reports 48,000 requests per second against web server WEB-PORTAL-01, about 60 times normal, mostly GET requests for /search from roughly 3,000 source addresses including 192.0.2.10 and 192.0.2.44. Response latency rose to 9 seconds and error rates to 35 percent. Upstream provider traffic statistics were not provided.

attributes.note: SYNTHETIC test data created for CADE development. Not a real incident.
